functions.enforce_payment_flow_version_immutable: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION enforce_payment_flow_version_immutable() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ BEGIN IF OLD.payment_flow_version IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.payment_flow_version THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'payment_flow_version is immutable once set (booking %, was %, attempted %)', OLD.id, OLD.payment_flow_version, NEW.payment_flow_version; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$

triggers.trg_payment_flow_version_immutable@booki: CREATE TRIGGER trg_payment_flow_version_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON bookings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_payment_flow_version_immutable()

functions.enforce_grace_period_started_at_immutabl: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION enforce_grace_period_started_at_immutable() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ BEGIN IF OLD.grace_period_started_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.grace_period_started_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.grace_period_started_at THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'grace_period_started_at is immutable once set (booking %, was %, attempted %)', OLD.id, OLD.grace_period_started_at, NEW.grace_period_started_at; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$

triggers.trg_grace_period_started_at_immutable@bo: CREATE TRIGGER trg_grace_period_started_at_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON bookings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_grace_period_started_at_immutable()
